module: Main pacenote editing form in the rally editor. It displays the name, the actions (Place Vehicle, TODO, Done, Delete..., merge with previous/next), the status, then the sub-form depending on the audio mode (structured via structuredForm, custom via customForm, or freeform with a text field, audio playback and "Generate from Structured"), the calibration metadata, the measurements, and the options (audio mode override, trigger type). A modal confirmation precedes deletion. The module returns a class C constructor.
notes: No exported function: you get an instance with require(...)(pacenoteToolsWindow).
A "Playback Rules" help is defined (variables currLap and maxLap, free evaluated Lua code); the corresponding input field is commented out in this file.

init.desc: Constructor: stores the tools window and its state, with no pacenote.

setPacenote.desc: Sets the edited pacenote and resets StructuredForm, CustomForm and MeasurementsForm.

clearState.desc: Resets the editing state (ongoing edit, deletion confirmation) and removes the pacenote.

draw.desc: Draws the form in an imgui child area, or "No pacenote selected".
